title: Ordinary and cochain horizontal reduction adjoints of semilinear systems
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with object universe $c$ and morphism universe $v$, essentially small in universe $\max(c,v,r)$, and let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology. Let $B_n$ be a strict inverse tower of commutative ring sheaves with values in universe $\max(c,v,r)$ and adjacent maps $\tau_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n$. Use the actual strict semilinear systems, their evaluation $e_n$ and horizontal transition $t_{m,n}:e_m M\to\operatorname{Res}_{B_m\to B_n}(e_n M)$ of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], and let $A$ be the ordinary derived calculus datum of [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus], with ordinary scalar adjunction $E_{m,n}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{B_m\to B_n}$. For every $n\le m$ and system $M$, define its ordinary horizontal reduction adjoint to be $\alpha_{m,n}(M):E_{m,n}(e_mM)\to e_nM$, the inverse of the adjunction Hom equivalence applied to the actual $t_{m,n}(M)$. For every unbounded cochain complex $P$ of these systems [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], define its cochain horizontal reduction adjoint $E_{m,n}(e_mP)\to e_nP$ degreewise by $\alpha_{m,n}(P^k)$ for $k\in\mathbf Z$. The differentials commute by naturality of the actual transition and the adjunction Hom equivalence. These definitions use every actual transition, including equal indices; they impose neither normalization nor flatness and do not assert tensor compatibility.
